title: Fish Audio Launches Drama 3 to Direct AI Voices and Edit a Single Word
key_facts: Fish Audio announced Drama 3, a new text-to-speech model, on 13 Oct 2026.

Creators can direct delivery in ordinary language, including changes within a sentence (for example calm turning to panicked), using bracketed directions, paired tags on selected words, and an Auto Tag feature that suggests directions.

Audio inpainting lets a user select part of an existing performance, change the instructions and regenerate just that segment, down to a single word, keeping the surrounding audio; co-founder and chief scientist Shijia Liao says the model uses sound on both sides of the edit.

It can generate a full multi-speaker scene in one pass, with each character keeping a distinct voice, and offers phoneme-level pronunciation control in languages including English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
Unite.AI says the workflow benefits are potential, not measured, and the release gives no independent evaluation of how reliably single-word repairs preserve the surrounding audio.
The API lists it as drama-3-preview; the product page and documentation still call it a preview, and Fish Audio says results vary between takes and the model will keep changing.
Fish Audio says it serves more than 15 million users and has reached $21 million in annual recurring revenue (company-reported).
Launch offer: API usage discounted by 80% for the first 30 days, and three free months for qualifying enterprises switching voice providers.
